schema_manifest.query: SELECT column_name,datatype,unit FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name='des_dr2.main' AND column_name IN ('coadd_object_id','ra','dec','mag_auto_g','mag_auto_r','mag_auto_i','mag_auto_z','mag_auto_y','magerr_auto_i','spread_model_i','spreaderr_model_i','flags_i','imaflags_iso_i') ORDER BY column_name

optical_manifest.query: SELECT TOP 10000 coadd_object_id,ra,dec,mag_auto_g,mag_auto_r,mag_auto_i,mag_auto_z,mag_auto_y,magerr_auto_i,spread_model_i,spreaderr_model_i,flags_i,imaflags_iso_i FROM des_dr2.main WHERE ra BETWEEN 53.023380214998845 AND 53.249453118401156 AND dec BETWEEN -27.889000000000003 AND -27.689 ORDER BY coadd_object_id
optical_manifest.retrieval_geometry: Numeric bounding box, exact spherical cone trimming locally

gaia_manifest.query: SELECT TOP 10000 source_id,ra,dec,ref_epoch,parallax,parallax_error,pmra,pmdec,phot_g_mean_mag,bp_rp,ruwe,astrometric_params_solved,visibility_periods_used,phot_bp_rp_excess_factor,duplicated_source FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',53.1364166667,-27.789,0.1)) ORDER BY source_id

allwise_manifest.query: SELECT TOP 10000 designation,ra,dec,w1mpro,w2mpro,w1sigmpro,w2sigmpro,w1snr,w2snr,cc_flags,ext_flg,nb,ph_qual FROM allwise_p3as_psd WHERE CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec),CIRCLE(53.1364166667,-27.789,0.1))=1 ORDER BY designation

crowding_followup.interpretation: Adaptive follow-up to the Gaia fit/excess lead, using the same open fields. Excludes the sole optical primary and censors distances that exceed the distance to the cone boundary. DES deblends/flags can create apparent neighbours; projected separation is not a physical companion classification. No independent confirmation.

analysis.selection: All catalog flags retained. Magnitude values outside (-10,40), including DES 99 sentinels, are unavailable for magnitude summaries. Spread_model is a morphology measurement, not a trusted object class. No parallax inversion or redshift inferred. Catalog magnitudes differ in bandpass and cannot be treated as a common distance axis.

calibration.coverage: Nonempty cone demonstrates some DES catalog coverage, not complete spatial coverage or a measured selection function.
